headline: Anupam Rasayan files revised financial results for Q2 FY27
hook: Error fixed in September quarter filing
summary: Anupam Rasayan India Limited has submitted revised standalone and unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The revision corrects an inadvertent clerical error in the initial filing submitted to the stock exchanges. No broader operational impact or business restructuring was disclosed in the update. Retail shareholders holding the stock should note that this is a routine administrative correction of reported numbers.
why_it_matters: Routine filing correction with no impact on business fundamentals
